title: Event venue: confirming equipment and prices across a weekend
brief: Verify whether Hean Hall can accommodate 80 attendees on November 13, 18:00-21:00, within a CNY 12000 budget, with a projector required. Confirm the total cost, cancellation terms, availability, and projector availability, with verifiable written evidence.

pages.title: Hean Hall introduction
pages.text: Hean Hall offers event-space hire. Old introduction: prices from CNY 8000, capacity 100, projector included. Consult the contact page for specific dates and facilities. This page also links documents including a recent event price breakdown.
pages.snippet: Hean Hall event-space introduction: starting prices, capacity, and projector information.

documents.title: Equipment maintenance notice (November).pdf
documents.text: November projector maintenance plan: the projector is scheduled for maintenance throughout November 13. No projector or replacement projector is available during that period. Other months will be announced separately.

documents.title: Recent 80-person event price breakdown.pdf
documents.text: Recent price breakdown for an 80-person event: venue hire CNY 8200, service fee CNY 1400, total CNY 9600. (Compiled by the record holder.)

pages.title: Hean Hall contacts
pages.text: Ask receptionist Chen Zhi for staff email addresses and subsequent contact channels. Office hours: Monday-Friday 09:00-12:00 and 13:00-17:00. Chen Zhi handles external inquiries and referrals; prices, scheduling, and equipment require confirmation by the respective staff.
pages.snippet: Hean Hall contact channels and office hours.

pages.title: Hean Hall equipment-support application
pages.text: Hean Hall venue booking instructions: supply the event date, time slot, and headcount. The respective staff must confirm prices, availability, and equipment separately. Apply using the registration form on this page for a written equipment-support decision. This page only explains the required information; it cannot complete a booking online.
pages.snippet: Hean Hall booking materials and equipment-support registration instructions; online booking is unavailable.

form.title: Equipment-support application
form.submit_instructions: This form cannot be submitted directly online. Use the hall's equipment-support registration channel; its name is given in the latest notice on the official introduction page.

authorization: Only communicate, make inquiries, check status, supply materials already held, and obtain written confirmation. Do not pay, place orders, sign contracts, or make formal business commitments.

conclusion_options.unsuitable: A necessary condition is not met

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
